name: application-video-player
title: Video Player
description: A custom video player chrome — poster frame, center play button, and a bottom controls bar with scrub, time, volume, playback speed, and fullscreen.
useWhen: Embedding video with full custom playback chrome — scrub position, buffered range, time, volume, speed, and fullscreen — rather than the browser's native controls.
Brand consistency across the player matters, since native <video controls> styling can't be themed.
avoidWhen: You only need to scrub a media timeline without full playback chrome around it — use `Timeline Scrubber` for that narrower case.
Native browser controls are acceptable — the plain <video controls> element is far less code to maintain.
responsiveBehavior: The player keeps a 16:9 aspect-ratio container that scales with its parent width; the controls bar and scrub track stretch full-width at any size.
accessibility: The center play button and the controls-bar play button both carry aria-label="Play" since only an icon is shown.
Mute and fullscreen buttons carry aria-labels; the current time is shown as visible text ("2:14 / 8:47"), not solely conveyed by scrub position.
The scrub track's played/buffered regions are distinguished by both color and the draggable thumb position, not color alone.

variants.title: Poster with controls bar
variants.description: A 16:9 poster frame with a centered play button and a bottom gradient controls bar: play, time, mute + volume, playback speed, and fullscreen.
accessibility: Icon-only buttons (play, mute, fullscreen) each carry a descriptive aria-label.

variants.title: Poster with controls bar (Dark)
variants.description: Video player adapted for a dark page context, with a subtle ring border for edge definition against a near-black surrounding background.
accessibility: The player's own chrome stays dark by convention regardless of page theme, since video controls are traditionally dark-on-video.
